summary: Compiled TikZ for the trapezoid figure (ABCD with dashed FE and diagonal AE) is in version 3, the best version. The latest critic run scored it 0.90 with must_repair=false, and all six labels A–F are present and correctly placed. The one remaining note is about the dash weight of FE. It flipped between "too heavy" (v2) and "too fine" (v3), so I left it alone as flaky.
